title: cicer incisum
intro: Cicer incisum, commonly known as the Berseem clover, is a perennial legume native to the Middle East and Mediterranean regions. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and improve digestion due to its fiber content. The bioactive constituents of Cicer incisum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Additionally, Cicer incisum has been used to treat conditions like insomnia and anxiety due to its sedative effects.
